status: Core increment GPU verified on Apple M1 Safari. Not full ES2025 or 1.0 qualification.
sourceSnapshotNote: Includes concurrent standalone worker modules; only bundled artifacts are GPU-qualified.

summary.method: Host BigInt used only to marshal API values and as independent test oracle; all guest arithmetic executes through WGSL.

Fixed native oracles for infinite two-complement bitwise operations, signed arithmetic shifts, negative/huge counts, unsigned-right-shift TypeError, exact2048bit boundary, explicit overflow resources and retained-result GC. Guest arithmetic uses only WGSL.

summary.note: Fixed native-verified expectations. Pending BigInt mixed comparisons/coercion and custom Symbol protocols produce explicit Unsupported; they are not counted as supported execution.

summary.method: Fixed expectations and isolated native realms across class instances, method home objects, super, new.target, closure captures, object spread, JSON.stringify and copying Array methods. Every GC fixture requires a positive collection count in every lane.

Fixed value expectations; guest try/catch verifies exact expected exception prototype; unexpected compiler/runtime boundaries fail. Required callback records resume one instruction per dispatch; collection-pressure probes require a positive collection count in every lane.
